payload.posture: Read Revelation 1:4–11 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the opening blessing moves through witness, firstborn, rule, love, blood, release, Kingdom, priests, and coming. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
